description_expanded: Your lucky family and friends will be "doing it right" at this stately, accessible-friendly, three-story Dune Allen Beach vacation home. With five bedrooms, four and one-half baths, and accommodations for 14 guests, it boasts a prime location on Scenic 30A near the emerald-toned gulf and Allen Lake, perfect for fishing, kayaking, and paddleboarding. Close to Topsail Hill Preserve State Park , it offers stunning trails and old-growth forests to explore. Dune It Right features a charming Old Florida style with three levels of furnished verandas and a rooftop observation deck offering panoramic views of the lake and gulf. Accessibility features include a ramp in the garage, an elevator to all floors, a lift for the third-floor bed, and an accessible bathtub. The first floor welcomes you with an open bonus living area, abundant natural light, and access to a covered patio with a 10x20 heated private pool, gas grill, and chaise lounges. A guest bedroom with a king-size bed and shared ensuite bath is also on this level. The second floor's bright main living area has chic furnishings and a tropical flair. It includes a gray couch, white armchairs, and a dining table for eight. The state-of-the-art kitchen features custom cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a wide bar with straw-woven chairs. This level also has two guest bedrooms: one with a king-size bed and the other perfect for kids with twin bunk beds and trundles. A hall bath, half bath, and laundry room add convenience. On the third floor, the primary and guest bedrooms both have king-size beds and luxurious ensuite baths with soaking tubs and walk-in showers. The primary bedroom includes a bed lift, an accessible bathtub, and a romantic balcony leading to the rooftop deck. A coffee bar on the landing provides a refreshing morning brew. This home's prime location is near popular restaurants, beach bars, grocery stores, and shopping venues. The nearby Gulf Place offers dining, shopping, and events, while the renowned Vue on 30A and Stinky's Fish Camp restaurants are just a short distance away. Dune Allen Beach serves as the western gateway to Scenic 30A's idyllic coastal villages, offering specialty shops, galleries, festivals, and family amusements. Plan your next family beach vacation at "Dune It Right!" First Floor: Bonus Den with Patio Access, King Bedroom with Shared Walk-In Shower, Garage Access with Ramp. Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Dining, King Bedroom, Hall Bath, Bunk Room with Two Twin Bunks and Trundles, Powder Room, Laundry. Third Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub + Balcony Access, Bed Lift, Accessible Bathtub, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Soaking Tub. Fourth Floor: Observation Deck with Gulf and Lake Views. *Add $50.00 per day to heat the pool (available Oct-April if needed)
